description:
NameAlert is a macOS menu bar app that alerts you the moment someone says your name or any keyword you choose during calls, meetings, or videos. Speech transcription runs entirely on your Mac, keeping your audio private.

What it does
• Listens to audio from calls, meetings, and videos via system audio, or from your microphone.
• Detects your name or custom keywords and phrases.
• Supports spelling and nickname variants for each rule, such as Bala, Balakumar, and BK.
• Sensitivity settings per rule: Exact, Balanced, or Loose. Balanced catches small speech variations while ignoring similar everyday words.
• Listening modes: always listen, or listen only when you are on an active call by detecting when another app uses the microphone.
• Displays what was said around your name (the last ~30 seconds of transcript) so you know what was asked.
• Snooze alerts for 15 minutes, 1 hour, or until tomorrow.
• Searchable history of mentions stored only on your Mac, which can be turned off at any time.
• Live transcript window to inspect ongoing transcription.

Alerts
• Sound alert using system sounds.
• macOS notification with Snooze and Open History buttons.
• Alarm that keeps ringing until you dismiss it.
• Screen flash for visual notification.
• Push notification to your phone via ntfy.
• Telegram voice call to your phone via CallMeBot.
• Webhook alert with signed JSON for Slack, Home Assistant, Zapier, or n8n.

Privacy
• Audio never leaves your Mac.
• The words around a mention leave only if you set up ntfy, a Telegram call or a webhook — and only to the service you chose.
• Speech transcription runs on-device using Apple speech recognition, or a small local model on Macs without it. That model is downloaded once from huggingface.co.
• Free, with no account, no ads, and no analytics.

Shortcuts and automation
• Shortcuts and Siri actions to start, pause, snooze, add keywords, and view recent mentions.
• namealert:// URL scheme supporting start, pause, toggle, resume, snooze?minutes=30, open/settings, open/history, and open/live.

Requirements
• macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
• Apple silicon and Intel Macs supported.
• Screen & System Audio Recording permission (used only to hear call and video audio via ScreenCaptureKit; NameAlert never records or saves screen content).
• Microphone permission (optional, for people in the room).
• Speech Recognition permission (only on older Macs that use Apple's older on-device recognizer).
• Notifications permission (optional).
promotionalText: NameAlert listens to calls and meetings on your Mac and alerts you the moment someone says your name or keyword. Free. No account. Your audio never leaves your Mac.
